The property comprises of hallway/entrance , separate modern fitted kitchen including fridge/freezer , dishwasher, washing machine , gas hob, and oven. Double doors leading onto gated terrace/garden area, which can also be used as a driveway. Bright and spacious living area, downstairs WC, carpeted stairs leading upstairs to two double bedrooms and family bathroom with white suite and shower over bath. The property is conveniently located within walking distance to both Sutton Common and Sutton Main Line Stations, various local bus routes , as well as being close by to Sutton High Street, offering an excellent selection of local shops, amenities, restaurants ,cafes and open green spaces. Other benefits include loft access, street permit parking , gas central heating and double-glazed windows.
